newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.43 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.43 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1425 to the dollar, up from 3.1555 on Wednesday and at 1.8595 to the mark, down from 1.8485, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.43 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Wednesday's 2.47 percent fix.
According to Reuters' calculations, the zloty was fixed at 2.40 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with intraday currency moves on world markets.
